data.long_meaning: The name Sanjita is derived from the Sanskrit language, it is a combination of two words ‘San’ meaning born and ‘Jita’ meaning victory. It signifies that a girl named Sanjita is born of Goddess Durga, and she is a victorious one. This name signifies strength, courage, and resilience. The name Sanjita carries the meaning “Born of Goddess Durga” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sanjita usually hope their child will grow to embody born of goddess durga and live with faith, good character and purpose.
